newsitem.title: USA: Natwest Bank sells $500 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Natwest Bank sells $500 mln notes.

text.p: The following Yankee issue from National Westminster Bank Plc was priced on Wednesday, according to lead manager JP Morgan Securities Inc.
The deal is the first Yankee offering from Natwest since 1993, according to syndicate officials.
AMT $500 MLN COUPON 7.75 PCT MATURITY PERPETUAL
TYPE SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 99.875 FIRST PAY 10/16/1997
LAST MOODY'S AA3 YIELD 7.768 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P A-PLUS SPREAD +85 BP CALLABLE NON-CALL
NOTE: THE NOTES PAY A FIXED INTEREST RATE COUPON FOR THE FIRST 10.5 YEARS. AFTER OCTOBER 16, 2007, THE COUPON STEPS-UP TO LIBOR +145 BASIS POINTS IF THE NOTES ARE NOT CALLED.
